Hi Ella —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can scope a pricing recommendation that maps to your usage:

- Volume profile: you mentioned 7M tokens/month today and a projected ramp to ~35M tokens/month within 9–12 months. Can you confirm current steady-state peak (tokens/day) and expected monthly growth rate?
- Budget range: you said procurement has a $10–15k/month target for inference initially — is that the hard budget or flexible if we can show clear unit-econ improvements?
- SLOs: is 99th pct latency under 250ms a firm requirement for production queries, or is a 500ms tail acceptable if cost savings are material?
- Security/compliance: you flagged SOC 2 evidence and data residency — procurement@finexa.ai is looped for that.

Attached is a simple benchmarking sheet where we sketch a target $/1M token number under different configs (hosted vs dedicated vs private). We included comparative list-rate figures for OpenAI and Anthropic and a couple of open-hosts so you can see the unit delta.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the three bullets above (volume, budget, SLO).
2) Vanessa and I will produce a 1-page pricing proposal with breakouts: baseline hosted price, dedicated reserved option, and a three-month pilot price that hits your $/1M target if you commit to a volume floor.
3) Procurement shares preferred contracting timeline and any vendor evaluation checkpoints.

Can you reply with the volume/budget confirmation? I’ll aim to get the pricing note to you by Thursday.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Great to reconnect. Quick answers inline:

- Volume profile: current steady-state is ~7M tokens/month (avg), peak day ~450k tokens. We expect 40–50% month-over-month growth for the next quarter as we roll out to three additional business units; conservative estimate would be 25% MoM.
- Budget: initial procurement target is $10k/month (hard for Q3 pilot), but we can stretch to $15k if we lock a 3–6 month pilot with clear unit reductions.
- SLOs: 99th under 300ms is preferred, 500ms acceptable during pilot as long as we have monitoring and fallback.

I'll ask procurement to share the standard vendor questionnaire and timeline — procurement@finexa.ai will follow up separately.

Can you indicate what $/1M tokens you can hit on a three-month pilot at our 7–35M projected ramp? Also curious how your hosted list compares to OpenAI/Anthropic per your spreadsheet (high-level delta is fine).
